blurb: Port Dalhousie Pier Marina has over 400 slips equipped with 30 amp shore power, city water, and security gates. They accommodate sail and power boats up to 100 feet in length with up to a 14' draft. Prices include security, hydro, water, WiFi, unlimited pump-out, and one 30 amp service.
extraNote: No commercial use of vessel without prior permission and possible surcharge · No fuel, oil, lubricants, sewage or other waste to be dumped into marina or lake · Owner responsible for safe mooring with minimum two point tie up; marina may replace unsafe lines at owner's cost · Marina may board vessel if unsafe condition causes hazard · Owner must remove sunken vessel immediately or marina will remove at owner's cost
